Fellow bookworms, I'm struggling to find time in the day to do any reading as I get older. What is your advice and how do you manage to stay on top of your reading?
Try reading before you go to bed every night. Just have your night lamp on and read instead of what people do like Netflix or Reddit.

I read on my off days, often for hours at a time because I get so absorbed. I've actually taken to reading between laundry loads and setting an alarm to snap me out of it when it's ready. In the past I would read before bed, but I'd find myself not remembering any of the story because I read it while I was so exhausted.

I generally read during my lunch breaks at work and I also read during any meal time where conversation is not required.

In addition, if you are okay with audio, I like to use the "readaloud" feature with Google Books on my phone. Using that feature allows me to listen to a book while on my daily commute and pick up where that left off when I read it later. That helps me to keep a quick pace on books that I just don't want to put down.
